title: Chopin — Prelude in E minor, Op. 28 No. 4

reference.license: Public Domain (Mutopia, Magnus Lewis-Smith after Peters 1879). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: This is the deliberate stress entry: the gate is expected to fail it, and the point is that the failure is a number instead of an opinion. Everything the parser finds hard is on one page.
LilyPond \tempo 4 = 56 in 2/2, E minor (expectedFifths -1), \partial 4 pickup (pickupQuarters 1). 25 numbered bars plus the pickup as bar 0 = printedBars 26; no repeats, so performedBars is also 26.

Two printed fermatas (bar 23 rest and the final bar), so expectedHolds is 2. The hold gate is one-sided — inventing a hold is a wonky pause, missing one still plays the printed grid — so a 0 here is visible in the numbers without failing the time gate.
Left-hand quarter-note chords move in dense chromatic steps under a slow right hand; \tuplet 3/2 triplets appear in bars 12 and 18, which is what the 1/12-quarter onset quantum exists for.
The last two bars are cross-staff (\change Staff + \crossStaff), so staff is not hand there. Mutopia track names are the hand oracle.
Hairpins are engraved as a second spacer voice, and there are acciaccaturas and a turn. Grace notes are ordinary short notes in the MIDI; OMR may drop them.
pdf.sha256 pins the Mutopia letter PDF (1 page). Do not embed document UUIDs.
One printed \turn. realizeTurn spells it as four or five notes, so the allowance is the upper bound: expectedExtraNotes 4.
